suspected_defects.description: raft.restore() decides membership by scanning only cs.Voters and cs.Learners (new/source/raft.go:1401-1420). A node that is only in VotersOutgoing (being removed, or being demoted via LearnersNext) ignores a joint snapshot and answers MsgAppResp index=commit, so it cannot catch up while the joint config lasts. Contradicts raft.go:1398-1400 intent and raft_test.go:2789-2796. Observed in Go (TestEvOutgoingMemberSnap, both demotion and removal) and in the model (E12). Pre-existing in the old code but only meaningful now that joint ConfStates are restored.
